_doc: gpu_scheduler.py: collection always runs; tiered SFT rounds start in parallel once each round's data gate passes; each round: policy-interface gate (lowering chain, cameras, normalization) before SFT; balanced SFT evaluated end-to-end from normal OVMM init before the next round is created. H_exec is ONE frozen control protocol: chosen once by a small {1,5,10} sweep after sanity_v1 (prefer 5), then fixed for every later SFT/eval; H_pred stays 50. Eval reports success_count/eval_count per noise-seed pass. Thresholds are presets of this restore.

collect.legacy_commit_note: rows without code_commit are attributed by worker start time (supervisor log) and the deployed checkout's reflog; no fallback guess

data_gate_max_replay_reject_fraction_not: engineering alarm only (not a correctness threshold); replay-rejected trajectories never enter any dataset
reset_contract: hard world rebuild -> seeded task reset -> episode (frozen; no soft-reset path)
stop_after_round_note: Stage 1: after sanity_v1's balanced normal-init eval nothing new starts (collection continues); results wait for the user's review
